seo.title: Churchill Super Vitrified Crockery | Splendid Trading
seo.meta: Churchill Super Vitrified crockery from Splendid Trading: dishwasher and microwave safe whiteware, Stonecast, Studio Prints and Inked for trade kitchens.

Churchill Super Vitrified.intro: Vitrified crockery built for the pace of a commercial kitchen. Plain whites, hand-finished glazes and printed patterns, all made to take daily service and the dishwasher, with matching shapes and sizes across the ranges.

promo.alt: Plated autumn dishes served on Churchill Stonecast and Studio Prints tableware
promo.title: Built for the next sitting
promo.text: Hard-working whites, glazes and prints that go from the pass to the dishwasher and back, service after service.

why.title: Tableware that earns its place on the pass
why.alt: Churchill Stonecast plates and bowls in pastel glazes

points.title: Handles hot and cold
points.text: Almost every piece is marked thermal shock resistant, so it copes with hot food, cold rinses and the wash-up.

points.title: Dishwasher and microwave safe
points.text: All but a handful of pieces are dishwasher safe, and every ceramic piece is microwave safe, printed and glazed lines included.

points.title: Shapes that line up
points.text: The same coupe plates and bowls run through Stonecast, Studio Prints and Inked, so colour sits easily alongside white.

points.title: Edge chip warranty
points.text: Most lines carry Churchill's edge chip warranty. Ask us which ones when you order.

seo.title: Churchill Super Vitrified Bamboo | Splendid Trading
seo.meta: Churchill Super Vitrified Bamboo from Splendid Trading: 99 embossed white, Spinwash and Print pieces, all microwave safe, priced per pack.

Bamboo.intro: White Super Vitrified with a raised pattern taken from bamboo canes: texture on the table, no print to compete with the food. 64 white pieces run from 9cl stacking cups to 34.5cm oval plates, so one range can cover the whole menu. Selected plates and bowls also come in Spinwash and Print finishes.

image.alt: Churchill Bamboo white plate laid with Bamboo cutlery
